name: Ideogram 4
description: Ideogram V4.0q, strong at typography and layout. Image to image without a mask: the crop goes in whole and the stitch keeps the selection. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet.

fal.note: No mask input: the whole crop is rewritten at Strength and the stitch keeps the selection. Lower Strength to hold the composition. Ideogram 4 has no masked edit endpoint; fal-ai/ideogram/v3/edit is the older model that does.
